name: Kujō Yoshitsune
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 91); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1206.

poems.title: I’m sleeping all alone, and hear
poems.author: Kujō Yoshitsune
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 91
poems.text:
I’m sleeping all alone, and hear
The crickets round my head;
So cold and frosty is the night,
That I across the bed
My koromo have spread.
